Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: AetherPress
Description: Detects completed Penumbra mod installations and offers configurable Base, Normal, and Mask texture compression. Use /aetherpress to open settings.
Punchline: Automatically compress textures in newly installed Penumbra mods.
Changelog: Initial public release under ShaalaXIV. Adds Penumbra install detection, configurable compression presets, adaptive resolution, protected skin textures, and opt-in automatic optimization.

Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: Synastry
Description: A Penumbra animation launcher for organizing, pairing, and synchronizing multi-actor animations.
Changelog: EmoteLink is now Synastry, with the new /synastry command and branding. Right-click room invitations now open an Accept or Decline popup and can connect and join automatically.
